baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive opening قُتِلَ, the generic ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ, and the exclamatory مَا أَكْفَرَهُۥ form a compact verdict.
baseline_models.mechanism: The death branch gives the opening terminal force; the human-presence branch widens its target from one named person to visible humanity; and truth-covering plus favor-covering specify the conduct that draws the verdict.

activation_trace.role: Literal putting to death supplies the terminal register of the passive opening and makes the denunciation more than mild rebuke.
Visible human presence supplies the collective object whose exposed condition contrasts with what it conceals.
Rejection by covering truth supplies the charged act that explains the terminal verdict.
Concealing a favor adds ingratitude to denial and makes received benefit part of the indictment.

changed_reading.before: A bare curse against an unusually ungrateful individual.
changed_reading.after: A terminal verdict falls on visible humanity as a class because it actively overlays both recognized truth and received favor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The human noun and the intensive exclamation about covering stand directly beside one another.
baseline_models.mechanism: A being named through perception and familiar awareness performs the contrary operation of laying a cover over what could be perceived. The subduing branch of the opening then breaks the pretension of autonomous discernment rather than functioning only as a death wish.

activation_trace.role: Subduing until force softens turns the opening into the collapse of human self-assertion as well as a lethal formula.
Perception entering awareness supplies the human capacity that the following act of concealment frustrates.
Concrete overlay supplies the counter-operation by which awareness is self-eclipsed.

changed_reading.before: Human and unbelieving are merely a subject and its moral predicate.
changed_reading.after: The line is a perceptual paradox: the awareness-bearing human suppresses its own access to what is present, and that pretension is forcibly humbled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three focus words can be read through their social branches: human familiarity, repudiation, and adversarial matching.
baseline_models.mechanism: The one whose name carries familiar companionship repudiates relation and becomes an adversarial counterpart. The opening then condemns a social reversal: humanity converts nearness into estrangement.

activation_trace.role: The adversary or matched-peer branch supplies the hostile relation into which human familiarity is reversed.
Familiar comfort that removes estrangement supplies the social vocation being betrayed.
Repudiation supplies the severing act that turns a familiar presence into an opponent.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only an individual's vertical relation to truth.
changed_reading.after: It can also indict a horizontal betrayal in which the familiar human disavows relation and becomes an adversarial counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene gives covering a bodily and attentional mechanism: a face contracts, turns away, and becomes occupied elsewhere when a visibly present seeker arrives. Physical blindness belongs to the seeker, while failure of discernment migrates toward the one managing attention; thus أَكْفَرَهُۥ can describe enacted occlusion rather than only an interior creed.

activation_trace.role: Human perception supplies the focus capacity whose misdirection the scene exposes.
Overlay supplies the focus operation now realized as closing attention over a present person.
Facial contraction from discomfort makes concealment a visible bodily event.
Turning away supplies the directional act by which attention is withheld.
Loss of sight supplies literal blindness and lets the reading distinguish sensory lack from chosen occlusion.
The non-dominant split image of a person standing visibly sharpens the paradox that the supposedly unseen visitor is fully present.
The non-dominant mapped branch of knowing supplies the explicit epistemic test behind the exchange.
Being occupied away by something else supplies the mechanism that completes attentional covering.

structural_cues: 80:1-10 repeatedly alternates an arriving seeker with the addressee's face, orientation, knowledge, and diverted attention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facial closure, turning, literal blindness, a question of knowing, and distraction; I infer that their sequence enacts the focus root's covering as managed attention. A live alternative is that the scene only exemplifies bad prioritization and does not lexicalize أَكْفَرَهُۥ.

changed_reading.before: The exclamation condemns generalized unbelief or ingratitude.
changed_reading.after: It can condemn the practical act of making a present human disappear by turning face, knowledge, and attention away; blindness and failure to see are deliberately redistributed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written, purified, truth-bearing pages are carried through a root whose branches repeatedly remove coverings and disclose writing. Against that delivery system, focus covering becomes a refusal after disclosure, not mere ignorance before access.

activation_trace.role: Covering or rejecting truth supplies the focus response opposed to the preceding disclosure.
The written sheet supplies a stable visible bearer rather than an unavailable message.
Removal of impurity supplies a cleared medium that leaves less room for accidental obscurity.
Removing a cover supplies the direct counter-motion to the focus act of covering.
A book that discloses writing makes the bearers function as agents of legibility.
Truth carried through both speech and action supplies reliability to the disclosed material.

structural_cues: 80:11-16 places reminder, pages, purification, hands, and bearers immediately before the focus verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legible pages, purification, reliable bearers, and branches of uncovering; I infer an access-to-refusal arrow from that sequence into أَكْفَرَهُۥ. Alternatively, س ف ر may chiefly name bearers, with uncovering functioning only as a secondary resonance.

changed_reading.before: The human is condemned for not possessing or reaching truth.
changed_reading.after: The human is condemned for re-covering what has just been cleaned, written, carried, and made legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence expands قُتِلَ into a bounded life cycle: created from a drop, measured to a limit, caused to die, enclosed, reopened, and still unfinished with respect to command. The exclamation about favor-covering is thereby weighed against total dependence at every transition.

activation_trace.role: Literal death supplies the compressed endpoint that the following life-cycle sequence unfolds.
Concealing favor supplies the moral mismatch between radical dependence and claimed self-sufficiency.
Origination supplies the first transition over which the human has no authorship.
The small clear-water origin, including generative fluid, supplies material littleness against human self-magnification.
A measured amount reaching its limit supplies boundedness throughout the life course.
Causing force and life to depart externally realizes the passive terminal force announced in the focus.
Burial supplies an imposed enclosure that temporarily covers the dead human.
Reviving the dead reopens the enclosure and prevents death from being the final concealment.
Completion and discharge supply the criterion explicitly left unmet.
Binding demand supplies the unfinished obligation against which the life cycle is judged.

structural_cues: 80:18-23 asks about origin and then advances in order through creation, measure, path, death, burial, reopening, and noncompletion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered transitions and externally caused death; I infer that the focus passive is a proleptic compression of that whole dependency chain. The live alternative is that قُتِلَ remains only a rhetorical curse while the later death is a separate argument.

changed_reading.before: قُتِلَ is an isolated imprecation at the start of a new statement.
changed_reading.after: It is also the compressed terminal marker of a measured biography whose every boundary is received, making the human's concealment of favor radically incongruous.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same human root returns as the grammatical subject of a command to look, while food is framed as livelihood and good condition. This makes perception not merely an etymological possibility in ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ but an unperformed vocation: the covering human fails to inspect the support immediately before him.

activation_trace.role: Awareness through seeing, sensing, or hearing supplies a latent human capacity in the focus noun.
Overlay supplies the action that prevents the human capacity from reaching its object.
Directing eye or insight toward an object turns latent perception into an explicit task.
The repeated human root reactivates awareness at the exact point where looking is commanded.
Livelihood and good condition supply the nearby object whose sustaining value should become perceptible.

structural_cues: 80:24 repeats ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ and places it between an imperative of looking and its own food.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated human noun, an imperative of visual or reflective attention, and livelihood; I infer that this syntax activates perception as a responsibility latent in the focus noun. Alternatively, the repeated noun may only reset the addressee without importing a wordplay on awareness.

changed_reading.before: Humanity is simply the object of condemnation.
changed_reading.after: Humanity is condemned for refusing its own perceptual vocation: it is told to become aware of the sustaining evidence it has covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agricultural sequence activates the focus root's seed-covering branch but reverses its moral direction. Seed is properly hidden, then watered, the earth is opened, and growth becomes benefit; the human instead hides the benefit and truth themselves. The fault is therefore not covering in the abstract but covering the wrong thing and arresting a process meant to disclose fruit.

activation_trace.role: The cultivator's covering of seed supplies a productive counterpart to culpable concealment.
Covering over favor identifies the mistaken object of the human operation.
Directed inspection opens the material sequence as evidence rather than mere inventory.
Repeated pouring supplies the input that reaches what is hidden.
Cracking open supplies the reversal by which earth's cover does not remain closed.
Plant emergence supplies the disclosed result of temporary productive concealment.
The germinating grain supplies the object that may rightly be covered because it carries emergence within it.
Good condition and favor supply the benefit that human ingratitude wrongly conceals.

structural_cues: 80:24-32 moves from commanded inspection through pouring, splitting, germination, produce, and declared benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a seed-covering branch in the focus and a water-to-growth sequence in context; I infer a contrast between fertile concealment and sterile concealment of favor. A live alternative is that the agricultural branch serves only as a material analogy and is not a semantic shade of أَكْفَرَهُۥ here.

changed_reading.before: Every sense of covering in the exclamation is uniformly negative.
changed_reading.after: The context distinguishes two coverings: earth temporarily receives hidden seed so life can emerge, while the human covers the very favor and truth that should emerge into acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the acoustic threshold, every familiar identity is named and then abandoned: sibling, source and nurturer, father, companion, descendants. Each person's own affair becomes sufficient to occupy him. This activates the baseline social reading so that قُتِلَ can include the collapse of human familiarity and كفر the repudiation of relational claims.

activation_trace.role: Humbling and breaking force supplies a non-bodily collapse of the social self.
Familiar comfort supplies the human relational field that the later flight dismantles.
Repudiation supplies the focus action realized by fleeing every close claim.
Flight supplies the explicit motion by which relational nearness is broken.
Sibling kinship supplies the first close bond from which the person withdraws.
Origin, gathering point, and return supply the deepest source-relation nevertheless left behind.
Fatherhood and nurture add the complementary inherited bond that also fails to hold.
Close accompaniment supplies chosen intimacy alongside blood relation.
Descent and attribution to an origin supply the person's forward-extending identity.
Total enclosure supplies the distributive pressure that leaves no person outside the scene.
A person's consuming affair supplies the private burden that displaces every relation.
Sufficiency supplies the grim mechanism by which each affair fully occupies its bearer.

structural_cues: 80:33's branchless ص خ خ is used only as the abrupt acoustic threshold before the ordered stripping of relations.
80:34-37 expands outward through sibling, parents, companion, children, and finally every person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flight from an exhaustive kinship sequence and an all-consuming private affair; I infer that these events realize a social death latent in the focus combination of killing, familiarity, and repudiation. Alternatively, the sequence may describe only eschatological consequence, with no backward modification of قُتِلَ.

changed_reading.before: The opening kills or humiliates an isolated biological individual.
changed_reading.after: It can also announce the death of the relational human: familiar identity is dismantled as each person repudiates the bonds by which that identity was built.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending renders covering and uncovering on human surfaces. Some faces are uncovered, bright, and opened by good news; others receive an earthen overlay that overtakes them before the exact ك ف ر root returns and is paired with a branch of tearing the veil. The focus exclamation thus acquires a visible after-state: inward concealment becomes outward opacity.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the surface on which the two outcomes can become legible.
Overlay supplies the material action later rendered as a coating on faces.
The face as forward surface supplies the display plane for concealed condition.
Light and face becoming openly bright supply the positive pole of disclosure.
The appearance of skin and surface makes joy an exterior revelation rather than hidden feeling.
Dust and earth-color supply the contrasting opaque layer laid upon the face.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the direction by which opacity comes to dominate the surface.
The returned root explicitly identifies truth-covering as the condition behind the darkened surface.
Deviation that tears a veil supplies a violent counterpart: the coverer also violates the very boundary he uses.

structural_cues: 80:38-42 presents two face states and ends by repeating the focus root ك ف ر as a plural identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bright uncovered faces, skin opening with joy, dust-covered faces, overpowering darkness, and the repeated focus root; I infer that the exterior state manifests the earlier interior operation. Alternatively, the faces may show consequence without encoding an etymological cover/uncover contrast.

changed_reading.before: أَكْفَرَهُۥ names an invisible disposition known only by assertion.
changed_reading.after: The disposition becomes a surface process: disclosure brightens and opens one face, while persistent covering settles outward as an overtaking layer on another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across otherwise distinct scenes, covers repeatedly fail: writing is uncovered, the buried dead is opened and spread, earth is split for growth, faces become bright, and the final transgression itself tears a veil. Read against that sequence, the human's intense covering is not only wrong but structurally futile; قُتِلَ gives the coverer's terminal horizon.

activation_trace.role: Terminal death supplies the eventual limit placed on the agent who keeps covering.
Concrete concealment supplies the repeated operation that later openings undo.
Removing a covering supplies the first explicit counter-motion around the written reminder.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the reversal of bodily enclosure.
Splitting open the earth supplies a material demonstration that productive covers are temporary.
Tearing a veil at the close supplies the final rupture in the chain of failed coverings.

structural_cues: Uncovering, reopening, and splitting recur before and after the focus across text, body, soil, and final classification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several independent opening branches; I infer a cross-domain recurrence that makes human concealment temporally unstable. A live alternative is that these openings belong to separate local mechanisms and should not be read as one surah-wide causal pattern.

changed_reading.before: The human's covering is a settled state that the exclamation merely labels.
changed_reading.after: The covering is a doomed resistance inside a world that repeatedly discloses writing, bodies, seed, and surfaces; the terminal opening announces that it cannot hold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because passive قُتِلَ most immediately evokes actual killing, while the cited branch concerns mastering a fact. It remains focus-anchored in an attested ق ت ل branch and coheres with the exclamation's verdictive compression; downstream prose should present it only as an epistemic branch echo, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening passive can activate the ق ت ل branch in which a matter is so fully known that it is mastered.

activation_trace.role: Complete mastery of a fact supplies a secondary sense in which the human case is decisively closed.
Truth-covering supplies the fact pattern that the exclamation declares mastered and exposed.

changed_reading.before: The opening only wishes death upon the human.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary echo, it can announce that the human case has been comprehensively grasped and closed: his defining contradiction is exposed in one exclamation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus does not mention drink and the ordinary passive does not say that strength was diluted. It remains worth carrying because the exact ق ت ل inventory supplies breaking strength by water while the context places the human between a generative drop and emphatic pouring; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for humbled autonomy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus opening uses ق ت ل, whose inventory includes breaking a liquid's force through dilution.

activation_trace.role: Breaking a drink's strength with water supplies the strange material analogy of overconcentrated human force being reduced.
A watery drop as generative origin supplies the first reminder that human force begins in fluid dependence.
Water itself supplies the medium that materially counters imagined self-sufficiency.
Emphatic pouring supplies the abundant application of that humbling medium.

changed_reading.before: The passive opening destroys the human body.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, it dilutes the imagined concentration of human autonomy by returning the human to watery origin and dependence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the small human image in the pupil is a remote lexical branch, not the ordinary force of ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is activated by blindness, the commanded eye, and displayed faces; downstream prose should frame it as a visual recursion about seeing and being seen, never as the noun's primary gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus human noun carries a branch for the tiny human-like image visible in the eye's pupil.

activation_trace.role: The miniature human reflected in the pupil supplies a recursive image of the judged observer inside the organ of sight.
Loss of sight supplies the opening disruption of the visual system.
The eye as the locus of looking supplies the anatomical frame in which the reflected human appears.
The forward face supplies the finally displayed human surface that can be seen by others.

changed_reading.before: The verse addresses humanity only as the one who acts and is judged.
changed_reading.after: A secondary visual recursion makes humanity also the image lodged in sight: the one commanded to look is simultaneously exposed to view, so covering becomes self-occlusion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the death image comes from the non-dominant mapped inventory of س ع ي and cannot gloss يَسْعَىٰ in context. It remains packet-backed and focus-anchored because it activates قُتِلَ and the human-presence branch precisely where a seeker is ignored; downstream prose should label it a split-root social-death echo, not a lexical reading of the seeker.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a killing passive to the human as present person, allowing context to ask whether neglect treats a striving human as already absent or dead.

activation_trace.role: Literal killing supplies the focus endpoint reactivated as social erasure.
Visible human presence supplies the person whose arrival should prevent erasure.
The non-dominant split image of the dead supplies the strange trigger for reading neglect as treating the seeker like a dead absence.
Attention occupied elsewhere supplies the social mechanism by which a living arrival is functionally erased.

changed_reading.before: قُتِلَ concerns only the condemned human's eventual or wished-for death.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root echo, it also exposes a social killing: diverted attention can treat a living, striving human as though he were already absent among the dead.

strongest_changes: General condemnation became an enacted failure of face, attention, and perception in which literal blindness and chosen occlusion exchange places.
The isolated killing formula became a compressed measured life cycle of creation, death, enclosure, reopening, and unfinished obligation.
Covering split into fertile and sterile operations: seed is hidden so life can emerge, whereas truth and favor are hidden to prevent acknowledgment.
An inward moral label became outwardly legible through repeated uncovering, relational dissolution, and the contrasting surfaces of final faces.
summary.what_was_special: The three focus roots sustained coexisting lethal, perceptual, social, agricultural, textual, and surface mechanisms. Split-root and form-distant branches added live surprises without displacing the stronger readings, while a repeated cover-to-opening motion linked otherwise separate scenes.
remaining_uncertainties: The nonlethal ق ت ل branches may function only as echoes around a passive whose primary force remains actual killing or imprecation.
The seed-covering branch may support a material contrast without contributing a contextual sense to أَكْفَرَهُۥ itself.
The final face states may manifest the focus act of covering, or they may be consequences whose material vocabulary should not be read backward into 80:17.
The non-dominant split-root activations are packet-resolvable but deliberately remain exploratory because their surface-form distance is substantial.
